span.p:
Truck: side-load / automated ASL
· one-person crew, safety + labor win
· needs standardized carts + street geometry

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Truck: rear-load
· flexible, higher labor + injury exposure

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Truck: front-load
· 2–8yd containers, high per-stop volume

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Direct-haul to Subtitle D landfill
· pay tipping fee at the gate
· spends landfill airspace

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Transfer station first
· consolidate to walking-floor trailers
· cuts windshield time + fuel per ton

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Route to MRF
· sort to bales · revenue rides commodity price
· CONTAMINATION decides the P&L

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Compost / AD / RNG
· often MANDATED, e.g. SB 1383
· diverts putrescible tonnage + gas

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Compulsory diversion path
· ban or EPR obligation sets the floor

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Static routing
· fixed daily routes, balanced for density
· RouteWare / Routeware-AMCS / Trux

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Dynamic routing
· re-sequence from demand + telematics
· optimize stops/hour + windshield time

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Density is the profit driver
· maximize stops/hour
· minimize windshield time
· cost-per-stop is the KPI
